quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half ended September 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 610,658 million (+7.1% year on year), operating income +10.3%, ordinary income +8.0% and net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 12.9 billion (+15.7%), on a general recovery in demand. By segment: Infrastructure net sales JPY 172,210 million (+19.7%) and operating income JPY 2,709 million (from a loss of JPY 2,368 million) - Information & Communication Solutions profit rose on higher sales of data-center-related products (external sales JPY 102,943 million vs JPY 75,626 million a year earlier), while Energy Infrastructure profit fell on differences in project profitability despite firm domestic extra-high-voltage, renewable and functional wire demand. Electrical & Electronics net sales JPY 352,071 million (+0.4%), operating income JPY 13,094 million (-9.6%), on lower automotive battery sales and currency / copper-price effects. Functional Products net sales JPY 80,658 million (+11.3%), operating income JPY 7,365 million (-7.3%): data-center product sales rose, but the strong Taiwan dollar hit the copper foil business and demand at a major customer of the semiconductor manufacturing tape business changed. R&D spending in the half was JPY 15.0 billion. Management states that data-center optical network construction is expected to continue, and that while smartphone and PC demand recovery is slow, AI-related demand is rising sharply and functional products are expected to keep growing over the medium to long term.
